free_tier.stated: no free plan: the individual plans are Pro at USD 20, Plus at USD 100 and Max at USD 200 a month; Droid Core (a free open-weight model pool) and BYOK (free up to an allowance) are features of those paid plans, and the trial terms are unverified: not published on the pages read
free_tier.notes: the docs mention free accounts and trial states (a free account cannot launch Environment sessions) but publish no free allowance or trial length

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a coding subscription meters usage, not objects

interface_detail: the Droid CLI is a terminal UI, and `droid exec` is its headless mode: one-shot, read-only by default, `--auto low|medium|high` allows edits and commands, `-o json|stream-json|stream-jsonrpc` gives structured output, `-s ID` continues a session and `FACTORY_API_KEY` authenticates it. A Factory Public API at api.factory.ai and Droid SDKs for TypeScript and Python are also documented
tooling: the user installs the Droid CLI (`curl -fsSL https://app.factory.ai/cli | sh`, Homebrew cask droid, `irm https://app.factory.ai/cli/windows | iex` or `npm install -g droid`), or the Factory App desktop client; a Factory API key generated in account settings drives `droid exec` in CI. The vendor serves the models; BYOK custom models are set in ~/.factory/settings.json
chaining: a paid, vendor-served agent whose first wall is the rolling Standard Usage allowance: after it Droid Core keeps working on open-weight models under its own limits, prepaid Extra Usage (USD 10 minimum, no expiry) extends it, and BYOK keys for any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint in inference/ run free up to an unstated allowance

limits.value: three independent rolling windows of 5 hours, 7 days and 30 days on every individual plan, each starting when Droid is first used; a request needs headroom in all three; no request or token count is published for any window
Plus (USD 100 a month) is stated as about 5x the usage of Pro (USD 20) and Max (USD 200) as about 10x; Teams gives each seat Pro rate limits
after Standard Usage runs out the Droid Core open-weight pool has its own separate rate limits; Standard Usage does not roll over month to month, while purchased Extra Usage does

limits_note: the docs publish the window lengths and the plan multipliers (about 5x and about 10x Pro) but no request, token or credit count per window; the figure appears only in Settings > Usage or the /limits command, behind a sign-up. Missions share the same windows and need Extra Usage enabled
binding_note: the unquantified Pro rolling windows are the first wall; Droid Core and Extra Usage only move it

identity_cost.detail: paid signup collects card or bank payment details inside the onboarding flow, and payments that need 3D Secure authentication are not supported; sign-in methods (email, Google, GitHub), any phone requirement and any trial terms are unverified: behind a sign-up, the sign-in app does not render without a script

reliability_note: when a window is exhausted the current request finishes and later requests return a Rate Limit error; Standard Usage does not roll over; the docs list five deprecated Droid Core models (DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731, DeepSeek V4 Pro, MiniMax M2.7, Kimi K2.5, GLM-5.1) that will be removed
confidence_note: prices, windows, Droid Core, BYOK, headless mode and the payment step are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-02; the per-window quota, the BYOK allowance, trial terms and sign-in methods are unverified because they sit behind a sign-up. The pricing page FAQ answers are collapsed and were not read
